findings.text: non-blocking: describe_group and _describe_once re-implement the draft-to-citation-filter-to-review loop, its draft_index validation and its cost/token accumulation that enrich_signal_batch and recovered_call at imas_codex/discovery/signals/enrichment.py:280 and :196 already own, and fork their retry behaviour - group_enrichment.py:554 returns a structured-validation ValueError as a failed group where recovered_call retries it, so the two enrichment paths now disagree about the same failure class.

non-blocking: STATEMENTS covers only five of the statements the module issues, omitting PILOT_COMPONENTS_QUERY at group_enrichment.py:114 and the three write statements at :804, :821 and :896, so the evidence fragment's claim at docs/evidence/fragments/iter-signal-context-and-enrichment/pilot-enrichment-by-group.html:35 that every statement the module issues explains against the live graph is not what the gate measures and a typo in the write path would first surface in a live run.

non-blocking: STATES_QUERY is defined and never referenced anywhere in imas_codex or tests (git grep at cf48cb0e finds only the definition), so it is dead code carrying an unverified statement the module never issues.

non-blocking: _carries_generated_example drops every prompt templating output_schema out of both the parametrized verbatim guard and the walk's pair map, removing the schema-pairing assertion for signals/enrichment, signals/enrichment_grounding and signals/enrichment_output with no replacement, and it turns the base-sha KeyError DescriptionReview failure green instead of diagnosing the model-name mapping that produced it.

non-blocking: assert summary["components_failed"] == 0 (and the patterns_failed == 0 at :530) states an arithmetic identity of summarise, which computes component_failed as attempted minus described at group_enrichment.py:923, so given the described counts asserted two lines above it can never fail and it adds no guard over the awaiting-count logic the commit 81ce0041 introduced.

non-blocking: the fragment calls the token measurement an identical full pass, but logs/token-measure.json records delivered 84 of 85 groups while the writing run reported 0 failed groups, so the extrapolated ~210,000 tokens rest on a pass that differed from the run it stands in for.
